scope: Independent XLSX XML and rendered-image review; no workbook or builder modified by this review.
method: Read exported OOXML values, formulas and differential styles; evaluate the supported conditional-format expression subset with relative reference offsets; compare with independently computed minima. Also substitute four synthetic numeric scenarios in memory. No claim of native Excel execution.
minimum_contract: Smallest count among full LMX, supplementary LMX and foreign languages; supplementary must be strictly smaller than full; equal full/adjusted counts highlight full only; cross-language ties all highlight; incomplete analogies excluded.
